# Archive backend regression fixtures

`rar5-compressed.rar` and `rar5-solid.rar` are decoded from libarchive 3.8.1's
`test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar.uu` and `test_read_format_rar5_solid.rar.uu`.

Source: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/v3.8.1/libarchive/test
License: [libarchive notices](LICENSE-libarchive.txt).

The first contains one 1200-byte file; the second contains seven files sharing
a solid block. The indexed helper must list without creating entry files and
extract the requested final entry without writing preceding entries. The SDK
checks output CRC. Additional ZIP, AES ZIP, duplicate-name, Unicode, 7Z and TAR
fixtures are generated within `test/archive_session_test.dart`.

Navigation fixtures are generated by `test/archive_navigation_test.dart` and
`test/archive_viewer_integration_test.dart`: Chinese chapter paths with multiple
directory levels, images mixed with directories, ZIP containing CBZ containing
another CBZ, and a damaged nested archive. Widget tests use valid colored PNG
pages to verify rendered pixels and navigation, not just archive listings.

## Synthetic CB7 image fixtures

The following fixtures were created for this project on 2026-10-20 using
7-Zip 26.04. They contain only project-generated solid-color PNG images; no
external comic pages or licensed artwork are included.

| File | Container | Solid | Encryption | Archive bytes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| `comic-nonsolid.cb7` | 7z / LZMA2 | no | none | 508 |
| `comic-solid.cb7` | 7z / LZMA2 | yes | none | 418 |
| `comic-header-encrypted.cb7` | 7z / LZMA2 | yes | AES data and headers | 478 |

Each contains `001.png` (219 encoded bytes, 64 x 48 pixels, RGBA
213/52/83/255) and `002.png` (247 encoded bytes, 72 x 56 pixels, RGBA
47/171/99/255). These PNGs were encoded with Windows System.Drawing, with
each pixel filled with the specified opaque color. The public test-only
password for the encrypted fixture is `comic-fixture-password`.

Creation commands, run with both PNGs in the current directory:

```text
7z a -t7z -ms=off -m0=lzma2 -mx=5 comic-nonsolid.cb7 001.png 002.png
7z a -t7z -ms=on -m0=lzma2 -mx=5 comic-solid.cb7 001.png 002.png
7z a -t7z -ms=on -m0=lzma2 -mx=5 -pcomic-fixture-password -mhe=on comic-header-encrypted.cb7 001.png 002.png
```

`test/comic_archive_formats_test.dart` uses the bundled archive helper to
list and acquire these files, then Flutter codecs to check image dimensions
and every decoded pixel. The tests do not require an external 7-Zip command.
CBZ input is generated in the test, and the existing
`testdata/formats/format_comic_rar.cbr` provides compressed RAR4 JPEG/PNG
coverage. The separately documented libarchive RAR5 fixtures contain binary
files, not images; their extraction and CRC checks are not evidence of RAR5
image-codec coverage. No RAR writer was available on the validation machine.
